dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Your Excellencies. I welcome you on behalf of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What will you do next?

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, first, I shall announce to all the people that the relic has passed judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: And that the Guardian... will be Mr. Faurobert, who has come here from afar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Why would you do that?

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Trying to explain everything we've been through would be far too complicated.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Besides, it would take too long for them to grasp the concept of me being both a princess and a Guardian at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: When the time is right, I will make a detailed record of all that happened and then inform my people in writing.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: But until then, I will still preside over all the affairs of the kingdom as its "Princess."

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Once those "trial grounds" have been officially converted into "training grounds," I will set off.

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: Your Highness, do you still remember... Who the relic actually lit up for back in the cave?

response.speaker: Cimest
response.text: Hmm? Who it... actually lit up for?

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: Yes, as we were both next to it at the time. Of course, Your Highness fully deserves to be acknowledged, but I on the other hand... I...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're a champion who's been acknowledged by a champion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly, and that champion came specifically to ask for your help! How could you possibly still think you're unworthy?

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: *sigh* Maybe it's simply that you shine so brightly, Your Highness, that everyone was mistaken...

response.speaker: Cimest
response.text: Pfft... Well then, Mr. Champion, would you be willing to undergo another trial?

response.speaker: Cimest
response.text: I, Princess Cimest of the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells, shall personally bear witness to your deeds with this relic.

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: Of course! I do, I do, I do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He gets so excited whenever he hears the princess's name. Hehe, Faurobert...

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: Don't get me wrong! I—I'm doing this to fulfill the calling of Rainsong Pond! All that training I did, it was all to save... Uhh, I mean, protect Her Highness.

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: And it's such an important task, so naturally I must ensure that it all goes without a hitch...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you willing to travel together with Her Highness?

response.speaker: Cimest
response.text: Hehe, that's good to hear. Well then, Mr. "Champion" Faurobert, are you ready for my trial?

response.speaker: Faurobert
response.text: I am, Your Highness! Whenever you're ready, I'm ready!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! The relic's lit up again, and it's super bright this time!

choices.text: What are you going to do?

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: Estampe! Where have you been!?

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: Uhh, actually, I was strolling about the area, and had a go at that trial. It was fun, but I had to adopt a slightly different approach to pass it.

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: Mr. Horellou has filled me in on everything that has happened to you. Not bad, Mr. Guardian. Turns out you're pretty talented after all, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: Y—Y—You... If you'd been standing next to me, I'd have pushed you off, I tell you! I'd have pushed you off ten times if I had the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: Hence why I decided to take part in the trial instead. Faurobert, my friend, I always believed you could do it. And look... You did it!

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you're jolly good fellows, the both of you. Today is an auspicious day for our pond!

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Finally, we have a true champion. Though Mr. Faurobert hasn't saved a princess yet, I believe that his chance will come.

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I really didn't do anything, Mr. Horellou, other than standing by and watching as Her Highness did all the heavy lifting...

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Isn't that even better? Surely you didn't want the princess to be in danger?

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Ahh, that's quite enough, Mr. Faurobert. You were entrusted to fulfill the calling by Cibrelus himself!

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: Oh, pish posh! I'm not even sure if it was Cibrelus! After all, I've only ever heard of him, never heard him speak!

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: And you even accepted the princess's trial. You're a champion if ever there was one.

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: Can we just... Not talk about this for now? Please...

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Anyway, to sum up — the future of Rainsong Pond is now in your capable hands!

dialogues.speaker: Horellou
dialogues.text: Now, we can simply enjoy jumping for jumping's own sake! When I get back, I'll suggest to the committee that we make "fun" the focus going forward!

dialogues.speaker: Estampe
dialogues.text: That sounds like a proposal I'd be willing to get behind. On that note, let's head back.

dialogues.speaker: Faurobert
dialogues.text: Hey, don't leave me here!

dialogues.speaker: Saborn
dialogues.text: Both you and that paper frog were acknowledged as Guardians, Your Highness!?

dialogues.speaker: Souffache
dialogues.text: Unbelievable, unheard of! There is simply no precedent for this!

dialogues.speaker: Saborn
dialogues.text: And you'll have to make changes to the trial too... No, don't do this, Your Highness!

dialogues.speaker: Souffache
dialogues.text: You can't simply overhaul such an ancient tradition on a whim, Your Highness!

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, keep your voices down. My ears are starting to hurt...

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: It's all been decided already. Now, given that I am both a princess and a Guardian who has been acknowledged by the relic, you're in even less of a position to stop me.

dialogues.speaker: Saborn
dialogues.text: But, Your Highness...

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: The both of you may relax. I'll host a ceremony to train up hosts of reliable flying squirrels to defend the kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Only after that will I leave the kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Souffache
dialogues.text: Your Highness, we... *sigh* You...

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: Don't worry, you two. I can take care of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Cimest
dialogues.text: As the princess, in the end it is I who shall face the wild winds of the world on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Saborn
dialogues.text: ...As you wish, Your Highness.
